mechanisms.explanation: Of the 400 development hearts, 93 have no fit (ev-95d7f1707ae35212), all failing the annulus-coverage rule with no valve size assigned (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591, ev-c4a0b7e08735e627). The design only covers annulus diameters from 21 mm (minAnnulusMm of size 23) to 27 mm (maxAnnulusMm of size 27). Grouping failures by annulusMm band (ev-a875f695c1a02e6e) shows two distinct tails outside this range: a smaller-annulus tail below 21 mm comprising 6 no-fit hearts in the 18-20 mm band and 20 no-fit hearts in the 20-22 mm band (for example, heart-013 has annulusMm 20.3602109283815 against a limit of 21, margin -0.639789071618548, with lvotMm 18.6685379189905, sinusMm 28.5111190099033, and sinotubularJunctionMm 25.8848600777274; ev-80c17e59f3eab42b), and a larger-annulus tail above 27 mm comprising 30 no-fit hearts in the 26-28 mm band, 31 in the 28-30 mm band, and 6 in the 30-32 mm band (for example, heart-019 has annulusMm 27.3588421207855 against a limit of 27, margin -0.358842120785503, with lvotMm 28.069669760502, sinusMm 32.7155227494946, and sinotubularJunctionMm 29.9892814019414; ev-8130bb4e6ef7cd67). Because the upper tail is larger than the lower tail, the 93 no-fit hearts as a combined group have higher mean measurements across root dimensions than the remaining 307 hearts (ev-c5fa6b737e7d6ac2): lvotMm groupMean 26.2397743438473 vs restMean 23.5893006765396 (effectSize 0.78842208254492), annulusMm groupMean 26.1196504829399 vs restMean 24.1814269470922 (effectSize 0.783682598813269), sinusMm groupMean 34.5185607337525 vs restMean 32.3156775956045 (effectSize 0.661545609781026), and sinotubularJunctionMm groupMean 30.9120404307311 vs restMean 29.1595747136156 (effectSize 0.605181434509487).

mechanisms.explanation: 52 hearts are placed at risk by the stj-excess rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591). Even though their annulusMm fits within the 21 to 27 mm design range across sizes 23, 25, and 27 (ev-c4a0b7e08735e627), these hearts have a narrow sinotubular junction relative to their assigned nominal valve size. Profiling these 52 hearts against the remaining 348 hearts (ev-e4b3fb96f825b4ef) shows that sinotubularJunctionMm has the largest difference (-3.52013017907853 mm, effectSize -1.2156114728117, groupMean 26.5045097370466 vs restMean 30.0246399161251), accompanied by a smaller sinusMm (difference -2.57310305287558 mm, effectSize -0.772725978362664, groupMean 30.5892482692222 vs restMean 33.1623513220977) and a higher lvotOverAnnulusAreaRatio (difference 0.0731094229787099, effectSize 0.682085964814614, groupMean 1.02645440665182 vs restMean 0.953344983673109), while annulusMm is nearly unchanged (groupMean 24.2162817933461 vs restMean 24.6941922828066, effectSize -0.193233715024884). Individual heart inspections show the stj-excess limit is 25 mm for size 23 (heart-018: annulusMm 21.3162948513543, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 23.9075688982299, limit 25, margin -1.09243110177013; ev-9f761323d17e7e2a), 27 mm for size 25 (heart-086: annulusMm 23.5075668607675, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 26.48261056391, limit 27, margin -0.517389436090028; ev-5f099e74b6ae918b), and 29 mm for size 27 (heart-014: annulusMm 25.8633543516862, measured sinotubularJunctionMm 26.8311463740637, limit 29, margin -2.16885362593629; ev-d839ce86991e7b0c).

findings.title: Small sinus diameter and reduced sinus height relative to assigned valve size trigger sinus-clearance risk in 38 hearts
findings.explanation: 38 hearts are placed at risk by the sinus-clearance rule (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591), overlapping substantially with the stj-excess group to form the total of 68 at-risk hearts across sizes 23 (18 risk), 25 (24 risk), and 27 (26 risk) (ev-c4a0b7e08735e627, ev-4237111d416f4a74). findings.title: Annulus coverage gap below 21 mm and above 27 mm causes all 93 no-fit failures
findings.explanation: Of the 400 development hearts, 93 have no fit (ev-95d7f1707ae35212), all failing the annulus-coverage rule with no valve size assigned (ev-ddb7bf7de5a26591, ev-c4a0b7e08735e627). The design only covers annulus diameters from 21 mm (minAnnulusMm of size 23) to 27 mm (maxAnnulusMm of size 27). Grouping failures by annulusMm band (ev-a875f695c1a02e6e) shows two distinct tails outside this range: a smaller-annulus tail below 21 mm comprising 6 no-fit hearts in the 18-20 mm band and 20 no-fit hearts in the 20-22 mm band (for example, heart-013 has annulusMm 20.3602109283815 against a limit of 21, margin -0.639789071618548, with lvotMm 18.6685379189905, sinusMm 28.5111190099033, and sinotubularJunctionMm 25.8848600777274; ev-80c17e59f3eab42b), and a larger-annulus tail above 27 mm comprising 30 no-fit hearts in the 26-28 mm band, 31 in the 28-30 mm band, and 6 in the 30-32 mm band (for example, heart-019 has annulusMm 27.3588421207855 against a limit of 27, margin -0.358842120785503, with lvotMm 28.069669760502, sinusMm 32.7155227494946, and sinotubularJunctionMm 29.9892814019414; ev-8130bb4e6ef7cd67). Because the upper tail is larger than the lower tail, the 93 no-fit hearts as a combined group have higher mean measurements across root dimensions than the remaining 307 hearts (ev-c5fa6b737e7d6ac2): lvotMm groupMean 26.2397743438473 vs restMean 23.5893006765396 (effectSize 0.78842208254492), annulusMm groupMean 26.1196504829399 vs restMean 24.1814269470922 (effectSize 0.783682598813269), sinusMm groupMean 34.5185607337525 vs restMean 32.3156775956045 (effectSize 0.661545609781026), and sinotubularJunctionMm groupMean 30.9120404307311 vs restMean 29.1595747136156 (effectSize 0.605181434509487).
